_style: Always address the user informally with «сен» (сага, сени, сенин, imperatives without -ңыз: «Жаз», «Карап көр»); never «Сиз». The couple together is «экөөң» / «экөөңөр» («силер экөөң»), and «биз» / «биздин» when the couple speaks about themselves (e.g. «Биздин дарак»). The other person is always «сүйгөнүң» (the one you love; declines normally: сүйгөнүңдүн, сүйгөнүңө, сүйгөнүңдү); never жигит/кыз, күйөө/аял, жубай. Kyrgyz has no grammatical gender, so keep it neutral: use «ал» for they/he/she and avoid gendered nouns. A partner's name placeholder (%@, %1$@) is NEVER given a case or possessive suffix (no «%@дын», «%@га», «%@ны»), because the suffix depends on the name's vowels; rephrase so the name stays in the nominative or sits in apposition («%@ сага кат жазды», «Сүйгөнүң %@ сугарды», «%@ — сенин сүйгөнүң»). Quote marks: «…» outer, „…“ inner, no spaces inside, only where the English has quotes; ellipsis is the single character …; no space before . , : ; ! ?; em dash — with spaces on both sides; keep emoji, \n and the «·» separator unchanged. Numbers: space (U+00A0) as thousands separator, comma as decimal (1 250,5); ordinals with a hyphen (3-күн, 1-жыл); dates in day-month order with lowercase month names («14-ноябрь», «2026-жылдын 14-ноябры»), 24-hour time. Buttons and actions use the short verbal noun in -уу/-оо/-үү/-өө («Сактоо», «Жөнөтүү», «Катты мөөрлөө», «Кайра аракет кылуу»); full sentences use the informal imperative («Кайра аракет кылып көр»). Titles, tabs, buttons and headers use sentence case (only the first word capitalized: «Күндүн суроосу»), except proper names; keep Coupley, Premium, CoupleSync and Widget brand names in Latin script, everything else in Kyrgyz Cyrillic (with ң, ө, ү), and write AI as «ЖИ». Plural categories are ["one","other"]: after a numeral the noun stays singular, so one and other usually carry the same text («%lld күн» / «%lld күн»). Vowel harmony: when a suffix must follow a placeholder number, prefer a form that avoids the suffix («%lld күн бирге», not «%lld-ге»). Tone: warm, light, kind and natural, never cheesy or word-for-word.
